#### Import packages

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("curl")
```

#### Load data

```{r}
base_url <- "https://github.com/rforbiodatascience26/group_21_project/tree/main/data/_raw/"
file_names <- c(
  "77_cancer_proteomes_CPTAC_itraq.csv",
  "clinical_data_breast_cancer.csv",
  "PAM50_proteins.csv"
)
```

```{r}
multi_download(urls = str_c(base_url, file_names),
               destfiles = str_c("../data/", file_names))
```




Don't know what text goes in what files.

The data is made up of three files:

```{r}
proteomes <- read.csv("../data/_raw/77_cancer_proteomes_CPTAC_itraq.csv")
head(proteomes)
```
